name: Telecommunications
tagline: Cell tower EPC and lifecycle maintenance.
heroText: Cell tower EPC and lifecycle maintenance for reliable mobile-network infrastructure, integrating civil, structural, electrical, power and site-support disciplines.
intro: Our telecommunications capability brings together site preparation, foundations, tower erection, equipment-support infrastructure, power systems, earthing and lightning protection, testing and documented handover. For operational sites, Donmac provides scheduled inspections, structural and electrical checks, power-system servicing, fault response, component replacement, site housekeeping and maintenance reporting to support network uptime.
